research.name: interior[.]dev
research.note: Copy-in React micro-interactions, each a headless hook plus a styled example, such as a slider with detents and a hold-to-confirm button.

effects: slider that snaps to labelled detents within a capture radius, with a vibration on each capture
hold-to-confirm button whose fill drains back on early release and resumes from what is left when pressed again
tooltip group that delays the first tooltip and opens the next ones instantly while the group stays warm
loading button that keeps its width while the label changes between states
every component split into a headless behaviour hook and a replaceable styled component in one copyable file
